summary: Build a reproducible privacy-minimized ACM bulk importer
description: Download the official CC0 ACM register from a pinned manifest, verify archive and CSV structure, project every range into a holder-free read-only SQLite catalog, and emit provenance, freshness, and coverage metadata without committing generated data.
acceptance: One deterministic command validates the declared ACM download checksum and exact CSV contract, imports every source row into a SQLite range catalog, and records source URL, dataset URL, license, retrieval time, source digest, row digests, status counts, destination counts, and newest mutation.
The generated catalog omits holder names, KVK identifiers, addresses, and other unnecessary personal or organisation identifiers; generated databases and downloads remain ignored by Git.
Malformed archives, schema drift, checksum drift, duplicate source ids, invalid ranges, and zero-row inputs fail closed without replacing the previous catalog.

review_history.evidence: Approved against task acceptance: the checksum-pinned official CC0 archive built 74,984 source rows into an atomically replaced holder-free SQLite catalogue; metadata records source, dataset, license, retrieval, digest, row and category counts, and newest mutation; generated data is ignored; all required drift and malformed-input cases preserve the previous catalogue; 216 Python tests, 8 web tests, and all repository gates passed.
